title: Receipts
text: Any expense over $25 needs a receipt; without one, reject the claim. We pay what the receipt shows: if the claimed amount is higher than the receipt total, pay the receipt total (partial).

title: Meals
text: Meals are covered only while traveling for work (a trip in the employee's travel calendar on that date) or when hosting a client named in the note. Pay up to $75 per person per day; the part above the cap is not paid (partial).

title: Alcohol
text: Alcohol is never reimbursed. Remove it from the amount and pay the rest (partial).

title: Hotels
text: Hotels are covered up to $250 per night including tax, and the stay must match a trip in the employee's travel calendar. If no trip matches, escalate to Finance; do not reject, because calendars can be out of date. If a night is above the cap, pay up to the cap (partial).

title: Deadline
text: Claims must be submitted within 60 days of the expense date. Later claims are rejected.

title: Manager approval
text: If the amount to pay is over $500, the employee's manager must approve the claim before it is paid (needs_approval).

title: Gifts
text: Gifts, gift cards and cash equivalents are never paid through expenses, even for clients. Escalate to Finance.

title: Duplicates
text: A receipt can be claimed only once. If the same receipt (same receipt or confirmation number, or the same merchant, date and amount) was already claimed, reject the claim.

title: Splitting
text: Splitting one expense into several smaller claims (for example to stay under the $25 receipt limit) is not allowed. Escalate to Finance.

title: What is covered
text: Work transport (taxi, ride share, train, flights, parking), conference tickets, and work equipment and supplies are covered in full with a receipt, subject to the rules above.
